name: Oregon Women's Land Trust
notes: Owl Farm (OWL) is the trust's land: in 1983 OWLT was "in the process of buying OWL FARM" (per LC Mar/Apr 1983). The 145 acres OWLT "has bought" in 1976 are probably the same land as Owl Farm's 147 acres, but no listing says so.

name: Four Women
notes: No community name given in the listing; named from its opening words, "FOUR WOMEN."

name: A Woman's Place
notes: CLOSED: late 1981 to late 1982 (folded "in the past year" before the Dec 1982-Jan 1983 issue; exact date not given). "In the past year A Woman's Place (Athol, NY)... [has] folded" (LC Dec 1982; see observation 13). Founded September 1974, when seven women pooled their resources and purchased a former mountain resort (per LC Sept 1976).

name: Elwha River land
notes: No name given; the listing is a letter headed "DEAREST WOMYN:" (a greeting, not a name). Named from the Elwha River, which runs through the property. Owned by the gay community of Seattle (per LC Sept 1976).

name: Heraseed
notes: CLOSED: late 1981 to late 1982 (folded "in the past year" before the Dec 1982-Jan 1983 issue; exact date not given). Reported in LC Dec 1982 (see observation 14). No listing of it in this database.

name: Womonground
notes: LC June/July 1983 Directory of Contact Dykes lists "Sarah & Terry, Womonground, Rt 1 Box 2420, Troy, ME 04987 (10 miles NW of Unity)."

name: Susan Stone's land
notes: No community name given; named from the listing's heading, a person's name.

name: Herland
notes: Listed without a name in LC Dec 1982 under "DUFFY Z BAUM"; named "HERLAND" in LC Mar/Apr 1986 (c/o Duffy Z Baum, same address, phone and Pittsboro land).

name: Spiral Wimmin's Land Trust
notes: Listed as SPIRAL in LC Dec 1982 ("in the process of creating an alternative wimmins community"); as SPIRAL WIMMIN'S LAND TRUST in LC Mar/Apr 1986, holding "land in perpetuity." Advertised land for sale bordering its own in LC Mar/Apr 1986 classifieds: "78 ACRES: bordering wimmin's land in southcentral KY... $27,000! Also, 38 acres bordering our land... $16,500!"

name: Adlai Neubauer & Karen Hamm's land
notes: No community name given; named from the listing's heading, a person's name.

name: Susan B Anthony Memorial Unrest Home
Jan F Walsh's land
notes: No community name given; named from the listing's heading, a person's name. "Two Towers" opens the address and is probably the farm's name, but the listing does not say so.

name: Wisconsin Womyn's Land Co-op
notes: The co-op owns DOE (Daughters of Earth) Farm (per LC Dec 1982). Founded about 1977 ("Ten-year anniversary in '87," per LC Mar/Apr 1986). A land-for-sale ad in LC Mar/Apr 1986 classifieds gives the co-op's address and phone: "DYKE LAND FOR SALE: Detroit Lakes, Minn. 50 acres mostly woods, hills... J Haggard, Rt 2 Box 42, Norwalk, WI 54648."

name: The Web
notes: LC Mar/Apr 1986 classifieds list "WORD WEAVERS: has wonderful Lesbian publications! Write Word Weavers, Box 8742, Mpls, MN 55408," The Web's own mailbox.

name: North Crow Vacation Ranch
notes: Also advertised "NORTH CROW'S BIG SKY FULL MOON JUBILEZZIE'S: Strong Sun Moon June 20-26. Harvest Moon August 22-28. The Affordable Vacation" (LC Mar/Apr 1983 classifieds).

name: Rebecca, Susan, Anne & Maurine's land
notes: No community name given; named from the listing's heading, a person's name.

name: Lavender Hill
notes: CLOSED: about May 1983 ("sold last month" in the June/July 1983 issue). Sold "to the Hare Krishna... NO LONGER WOMIN'S LAND" (LC June/July 1983; see observation 57). Began as "an older womyn's community" (per LC Dec 1982).

name: Oakynwomyn
notes: Listed under the heading OAKYNWOMYN at the Twin Oaks Community address; the listing describes Twin Oaks, "a large community of women and men." Oakynwomyn is probably a women's group within it.

name: Laughing Rock Farm
notes: Listed as ROWDYBUSH FARM in LC Mar/Apr 1983; renamed Laughing Rock Farm by 1986 ("Laughing Rock (formerly Rowdybush)"), with the Wise Woman Center on the same land. Separatist land "since '78" (per LC Mar/Apr 1986). Susun Weed also advertised "HEALING INTENSIVES: Learn herbal medicine, psychic healing" from Box 64L, Woodstock, NY (LC June/July 1983 classifieds). The same ad ran in LC Mar/Apr 1983: "HEALING INTENSIVES: Learn herbal medicine, psychic healing skills with Susun Weed. Four days - $100... Fifth year. Wimmin only."

name: Northwoods
notes: "In its 6th year as womyn's land" in 1983, so it dates from about 1977 (per LC Mar/Apr 1983).

name: Misty Bottoms Farm
notes: Mimi Tate, at this address, also advertised "WOMYN'S WHITEWATER RAFT TOURS ON NEW RIVER: May-October" (LC June/July 1983 classifieds).

name: Silver Circle Farm
notes: LC June/July 1983 Directory of Contact Dykes lists "Gail, Gwen, Sue & Wolfspider, Silver Circle Farm, Box 100 Rt 5, Holly Springs, MS 38635."

name: Earth Current Womens Hermitage
notes: Listed as EARTH CURRENT FARM in LC Mar/Apr 1983 (a farm of "6 lesbians, 4 on the land"); as EARTH CURRENT WOMENS HERMITAGE, a healing space, in LC Mar/Apr 1986 (same address and phone).

name: Stepping Woods
notes: Land "woman-owned for 10 years" as of 1986, so since about 1976 (per LC Mar/Apr 1986).

name: Rootworks
notes: A rural feminist publishing center, publisher of Womanspirit and The Blatant Image (per LC Mar/Apr 1983).

name: Ozark Wimmin's Land Trust
notes: CLOSED: by March 1983 (land "wound up in legal dissolution eventually"; exact date not given). Reported in LC Mar/Apr 1983 (see observation 55).

name: Dutch Mountain
notes: Land in Frankfort, ME. Listed without a name in LC June/July 1983 under "REGGIE ODOM & EILEEN KENNEDY"; named "DUTCH MOUNTAIN" in LC Mar/Apr 1986 (c/o Eileen Kennedy, same address and phone).

name: Gathering Ground
notes: Listed without a name in LC June/July 1983 under "LINDA TISDALE/CAROL SHOREBORN"; named "GATHERING GROUND" in LC Mar/Apr 1986 (c/o Linda & Carol, same address and phone).

name: Greenstalk
alternate_names: Nan and Ruth's land; We Don't Have A Name Yet
notes: Listed in LC June/July 1983 under the heading "WE DON'T HAVE A NAME YET" (c/o Nan and Ruth); named "GREENSTALK" in LC Mar/Apr 1986 (c/o Nan or Ruth, same phone). Passive-solar home begun in 1982.

name: Arlene & Arline's land
notes: No community name given; named from the listing's heading, a person's name. On "our farm" for about 3 years as of 1983 (per LC June/July 1983).

name: Kringle/Wood's land
notes: No community name given; named from the contact, "Kringle/Wood." Known only from a classified ad headed "LEARNING BY DOING."

name: Chris of Coventree
notes: Homesteaded since summer 1981 (per LC Mar/Apr 1986). "Coventree" is probably the land's name; kept as printed in the heading.

name: Seneca Women's Encampment for a Future of Peace & Justice
O.W.L. Sanctuary
notes: Land purchased May 1985 (per LC Mar/Apr 1986). Not related to Oregon Women's Land Trust's "OWL" as far as the listings show.

name: Pagoda
notes: Excluded at first from LC Dec 1982 (listed under "These groups don't have land, per se"); included as a lesbian residential community on its own oceanfront property.

name: 240 acres near Fayetteville, AR
notes: No name given; named from its location. Known only from a LC Mar/Apr 1986 classified ad.

name: Women Only Ranch
notes: Known only from two LC Mar/Apr 1986 classified ads; the heading is used as its name.
